messages:
carmen: Dropping a new set of panels for API Key management in the Console. Looking for feedback on create/rotate/revoke flows, permission presets vs. granular controls, empty state copy, and accessibility checks. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/API-Key-Manager
jia: Nice work. Two priority asks: 1) rotation should clearly state whether the old secret is disabled immediately or after a grace period. 2) let users opt into automatic rollout window (e.g., 5/10/30 min).
owen: On the create screen, show a one-time secret reveal screen with a prominent note: "You will not be able to see this secret again. Copy or download now." Add a small download icon and a copy button.
lina: UX question: presets (read, write, embed) OR checkboxes for each capability? My vote: presets for default speed + an "advanced" switch that expands checkboxes with inline help text.
carmen: Agreed re: advanced. Also thinking a scope summary pill under the key name: e.g., "Scopes: Generations · Embeddings (2)" with hover to expand.
jia: Revoke flow: should we require typing the key id or name? Asking for parity with other consoles. Also propose a reversible soft-disable (toggle off) before permanent delete.
owen: Strong yes to soft-disable. And add an optional comment field during revoke for audit trail. Ops always asks for context.
ops-bot: Note: Audit Logs exist at /console/audit. Suggest adding a direct "View in Audit Logs" quick link next to each key entry for triage.
lina: Accessibility: ensure focus trap in modal, keyboard-only users can copy secret without mouse, provide clear aria-live announcements when secret is revealed or revoked. Color contrast: warning tag needs WCAG AA.
carmen: Copy thoughts — create modal header: "Create API Key"; body: "This secret will be shown only once. Store it securely." CTA: "Create and copy". Use a smaller secondary link to docs: "Best practices for key rotation".
jia: For rotate modal: short copy idea:
```
Rotate secret for <key-name>
We will generate a new secret and show it once. Existing secret will remain valid for X minutes to allow deployments to update. Choose grace period: [5m] [10m] [30m]
```
Add small checkbox: "Notify team via webhook when rotation completes."
owen: Implementation detail: mask the secret by default with a toggle to reveal. The raw secret should be downloadable as a file but never logged in plaintext in backend logs.
lina: Empty state copy proposal: "No API keys yet. Create a key to start integrating Redwood Inference into your app." CTA button: "Create API key". Subtext: "You can restrict keys by role, expiry, and IP allowlists."
carmen: Security UI idea: show a small risk score (low/medium/high) next to each key based on expiry, scopes, and last-used age. Hover explains what affects score.
jia: Love the risk indicator. Also add an expiry selector on create (Never / 30 days / 90 days / Custom). Default to 90d for orgs we onboard.
owen: On revoke confirmation, require typing the key's short id (last 6 chars) to confirm to avoid mistakes. Also show what will break (services last used by this key).
ops-bot: Reminder: expose rotate API endpoint: POST /v1/keys/{id}/rotate, with option grace_period. Docs PR needed.
lina: Accessibility test plan: I'll run the panel with keyboard-only and screen reader and post findings. Please ensure tooltips are accessible (aria-describedby) and not only hover-only.
carmen: Action items: Jia to add grace-period UI and rotate webhook option; Owen to update secret reveal interaction + download; Lina to run accessibility pass; I'll wire the risk score and presets. Meeting Friday 11am to review mocks.
jia: Will mock today and link in Figma.
owen: I'll add small code snippet in docs for server-side rotation using the rotate API. Example snippet: 
```
const res = await fetch('/v1/keys/abcd1234/rotate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ grace_minutes: 10 }) })
```
lina: Quick nit — make sure the copy for revoke is explicit: "This will immediately block requests using this key unless soft-disabled." Use distinct verbs.
carmen: Great feedback, thanks all. Posting consolidated checklist in the design file and will update when mocks are ready. :sparkles:
